subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

A comic play was performed by the comedian.

options.text: The comedian performs a comic play.
The comedian performed a comic play.
The comedian performance a comic play.
The comedian do perform a comic play.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "A comic play was performed by the comedian."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the comedian" at the beginning.
